ax.set_facecolor('#FAFBFD')

    ax.text(i - 0.05, 100, '100', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=6.5, color='#BCBCBC')

    for j, car in enumerate(cars):

        is_top = any(top_per_axis[k]['model'] == car['model'] for k in range(n_dims))
        if is_top:

        y = data[j]
        ax.plot(x, y, color=color, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.3, zorder=2, solid_capstyle='round')

    for j, car in enumerate(cars):

        y = data[j]
        ax.plot(x, y, color=color, linewidth=2.8, alpha=0.75, zorder=3, solid_capstyle='round')

    offsets_to_try = [
        (0, 5, 'bottom'), (0, -5, 'top'),
        (0.15, 5, 'bottom'), (-0.15, 5, 'bottom'),

ax.annotate('',

ax.text(1.5, 40, 'Power ↔ Fuel Efficiency\ntrade-off', ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#DC2626',

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    raw = json.load(f)

cars = raw['cars']['data']
dims = raw['cars']['dimensions']
dim_labels = ['Price\n(Affordability)', 'Fuel\nEfficiency', 'Power', 'Safety',
              'Interior\nSpace', 'Resale\nValue', 'Emission\nRating']

type_colors = {
    'SUV':      '#2563EB',
    'Sedan':    '#D97706',
    'Electric': '#059669',
}
type_band_colors = {
    'SUV':      '#2563EB',
    'Sedan':    '#D97706',
    'Electric': '#059669',
}
type_order = ['SUV', 'Sedan', 'Electric']

n_dims = len(dims)
n_cars = len(cars)
data = np.array([[c[d] for d in dims] for c in cars], dtype=float)
types_list = [c['type'] for c in cars]
models = [c['model'] for c in cars]

# Find top performer per axis (break ties by model name for determinism)
top_per_axis = {}
for i, d in enumerate(dims):
    best_car = max(cars, key=lambda c: (c[d], c['model']))
    top_per_axis[i] = {'model': best_car['model'], 'type': best_car['type'], 'val': best_car[d]}

# Figure setup
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(18, 10))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FAFBFD')
ax.set_facecolor('#FAFBFD')

x = np.arange(n_dims)
x_fine = np.linspace(0, n_dims - 1, 200)

# Draw soft axis lines
for i in x:
    ax.axvline(i, color='#D1D5DB', linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)

# Draw tick marks on each axis
for i in x:
    for val in [0, 25, 50, 75, 100]:
        ax.plot([i - 0.025, i + 0.025], [val, val], color='#9CA3AF', linewidth=0.7, zorder=1)
        side = 'right' if i == 0 else 'left'
        xoff = 0.05 if i == 0 else -0.05
        if i == 0:
            ax.text(i - 0.05, val, str(val), ha='right', va='center', fontsize=7, color='#9CA3AF')

# Only label left axis with scale values, show 0/100 reference on others
for i in x[1:]:
    ax.text(i - 0.05, 0, '0', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=6.5, color='#BCBCBC')
    ax.text(i - 0.05, 100, '100', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=6.5, color='#BCBCBC')

# Draw type clustering bands (min-max range per type per axis)
for vtype in type_order:
    color = type_band_colors[vtype]
    indices = [j for j, c in enumerate(cars) if c['type'] == vtype]
    type_data = data[indices]
    mins = type_data.min(axis=0)
    maxs = type_data.max(axis=0)
    ax.fill_between(x, mins, maxs, alpha=0.07, color=color, zorder=1, linewidth=0)

# Draw polylines — background (non-top) first, then top performers
for vtype in type_order:
    color = type_colors[vtype]
    for j, car in enumerate(cars):
        if car['type'] != vtype:
            continue
        is_top = any(top_per_axis[k]['model'] == car['model'] for k in range(n_dims))
        if is_top:
            continue
        y = data[j]
        ax.plot(x, y, color=color, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.3, zorder=2, solid_capstyle='round')

# Draw top performers with thicker lines
top_models_drawn = set()
for vtype in type_order:
    color = type_colors[vtype]
    for j, car in enumerate(cars):
        if car['type'] != vtype:
            continue
        is_top = any(top_per_axis[k]['model'] == car['model'] for k in range(n_dims))
        if not is_top:
            continue
        if car['model'] in top_models_drawn:
            continue
        top_models_drawn.add(car['model'])
        y = data[j]
        ax.plot(x, y, color=color, linewidth=2.8, alpha=0.75, zorder=3, solid_capstyle='round')

# Mark top performers with stars and labels
labeled_positions = []

def get_label_offset(xi, yi, existing):
    offsets_to_try = [
        (0, 5, 'bottom'), (0, -5, 'top'),
        (0.15, 5, 'bottom'), (-0.15, 5, 'bottom'),
        (0, 8, 'bottom'), (0, -8, 'top'),
    ]
    for dx, dy, va in offsets_to_try:
        conflict = False
        for ex, ey in existing:
            if abs((xi + dx) - ex) < 0.5 and abs((yi + dy) - ey) < 8:
                conflict = True
                break
        if not conflict:
            return dx, dy, va
    return 0, 6, 'bottom'

for i, d in enumerate(dims):
    info = top_per_axis[i]
    color = type_colors[info['type']]
    val = info['val']

    ax.plot(i, val, marker='*', markersize=16, color=color,
            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.0, zorder=6)
    ax.plot(i, val, marker='*', markersize=16, color=color,
            markeredgecolor='#333333', markeredgewidth=0.5, zorder=6)

    dx, dy, va = get_label_offset(i, val, labeled_positions)
    labeled_positions.append((i + dx, val + dy))

    label_text = info['model']
    ax.annotate(label_text,
                xy=(i, val), xytext=(i + dx, val + dy),
                ha='center', va=va,
                fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='#1F2937',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', facecolor='white',
                          edgecolor=color, alpha=0.92, linewidth=1.0),
                zorder=7)

# Axes formatting
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, n_dims - 0.5)
ax.set_ylim(-8, 115)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(dim_labels, fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold', color='#374151')
ax.set_yticks([])
for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)
ax.tick_params(bottom=False, left=False)

# Title block
fig.text(0.5, 0.97, 'No Perfect Car: Every Model Excels Somewhere, Compromises Elsewhere',
         ha='center', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', color='#111827',
         transform=fig.transFigure)
fig.text(0.5, 0.935, '25 vehicles across 7 dimensions  |  Scores 0–100 (higher is better)  |  Lines colored by vehicle type',
         ha='center', fontsize=10.5, color='#6B7280', transform=fig.transFigure)

# Legend
legend_handles = []
for t in type_order:
    patch = mpatches.Patch(color=type_colors[t], alpha=0.8, label=f'{t}  (shaded band = type range)')
    legend_handles.append(patch)
star_handle = plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='*', color='#6B7280', markersize=13,
                          markeredgecolor='#333333', linestyle='None',
                          label='★ = Best on this axis')
legend_handles.append(star_handle)

legend = ax.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='lower center',
                   bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.10), frameon=True, facecolor='white',
                   edgecolor='#D1D5DB', fontsize=9.5, ncol=4,
                   handlelength=1.5, columnspacing=2.0)
legend.get_frame().set_linewidth(0.8)

# Trade-off annotation: Power ↔ Fuel Efficiency
ax.annotate('',
            xy=(2, 48), xytext=(1, 48),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#DC2626', lw=1.5, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.15'))
ax.text(1.5, 40, 'Power ↔ Fuel Efficiency\ntrade-off', ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#DC2626',
        fontstyle='italic', fontweight='bold',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FEF2F2', edgecolor='#FECACA', alpha=0.95))

# Trade-off annotation: Price ↔ Resale crossings
ax.text(2.8, 8, 'Price vs. Resale — brand reliability\ncreates unpredictable crossings',
        ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#7C3AED', fontstyle='italic',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#F5F3FF', edgecolor='#DDD6FE', alpha=0.9))
ax.annotate('', xy=(0, 12), xytext=(5, 12),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#7C3AED', lw=0.8, linestyle='dashed'))

plt.subplots_adjust(top=0.90, bottom=0.14)
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='#FAFBFD')
print('Done')
